author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: অনুচ্ছেদটি পড়ে নিজের ভাষায় সংক্ষিপ্তসার (summary) লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Summarise: 'A library is a storehouse of knowledge. It is a place where many books are kept for reading. Students of all kinds go there to read books on different subjects. A library helps the poor students most, for they cannot buy many books. By reading books in the library, a student can widen his knowledge. So, every school should have a good library.'
items.model: A library, a storehouse of knowledge, is a place where many books are kept for reading. Students go there to read books on various subjects, and it helps the poor most, as they cannot buy books. Reading there widens knowledge, so every school should have a good library.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Rivers are a great blessing for Bangladesh. They give us fish and water. Farmers use river water for irrigation. Boats and ships sail on rivers and carry goods from place to place. Rivers also make the land fertile. But sometimes rivers cause floods and destroy crops and houses. Still, rivers are very useful to us.'
items.model: Rivers are a great blessing for Bangladesh, giving us fish and water and helping farmers with irrigation. Boats and ships carry goods on them, and rivers make the land fertile. Though they sometimes cause floods and damage, rivers remain very useful to us.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Hard work is the key to success. No one can prosper in life without labour. The great men of the world became great by working hard. An idle man depends on luck and wastes his time. But a hardworking man makes the best use of his time and wins success. So, we should work hard to achieve our goal.'
items.model: Hard work is the key to success, for no one can prosper without labour. Great people became great through hard work, while an idle man depends on luck and wastes time. A hardworking man uses his time well and succeeds, so we should work hard to reach our goal.
